string.text: Anarchists of the Zone.They profess the idea that the Zone is a reserve of unlimited freedom for everyone, therefore the laws, rules and conventions of the outside world lose their force here.Their motto is: «Do what you want, just don't bother others.»They fight against attempts to take control of the Zone, as well as against a clan of mercenaries.They are equipped mainly with small arms produced in the former USSR and Russia.

Adventurers and thugs from all over the world, who do not disdain any work, even the dirtiest.The motto is logical and predictable: «Money doesn't smell.»As long as artifacts are well paid, mercenaries will fight for control of their deposits.They are equipped mainly with Western-made small arms.
